contract: construct() -> (inner, center, side, angle): inner rows (x, y, angle_degrees) of n unit hexagons; outer hexagon center (x, y), side length and rotation; score is the outer side length
notes: Verification reimplemented from the AlphaEvolve mathematical_results notebook; the published construction reproduces the published value exactly with this evaluator (see tests/test_suite.py).
protocol_description: Reimplemented in this repository and cross-checked against the paper's published constructions/values.
name: Unit regular hexagons inside a regular hexagon n=12
description: Place 12 disjoint regular hexagons of side length 1 inside a regular hexagon, minimizing the outer side length; each inner hexagon may translate and rotate.
benchmark: Unit regular hexagons inside a regular hexagon
limitations: Paper reports over 50 mathematical problems but explicitly details 13 families in Appendix B. Unpublished full task inventory and internal Google assets prevent a complete runnable reproduction.

Official result notebook provides mathematical constructions and verification, but no AlphaEvolve search implementation. It publishes a subset of all evaluated problems; the full >50 mathematical problem inventory is not disclosed.

Paper Appendix B.3 writes max(abs(autoconvolution)); notebook B.3 reported 1.4557 construction computes abs(max(autoconvolution)). The notebook separately verifies the max(abs(...)) variant at 1.4688. These are not interchangeable metrics.
Execution interface inspected in pinned source. Full paper experiments have not been reproduced here.
